name: ASUS Aura headset stands (ROG Throne)
description: Per-LED lighting (17 underglow LEDs and the logo) of the ASUS ROG Throne, Throne Qi and Throne Qi Gundam headset stands. Adapted from OpenRGB's AsusAuraHeadsetStandController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The save command and hardware effects are never sent.
